title: Tooltips are shifted up when panel is vertical
line: Tooltips and popups of a side panel now open centred on their icon when there is also a top panel.
explanation: Panels are layer-shell windows, so plasmashell never learns where the compositor really puts them and tells Qt a guessed position that popups are placed from. For a side panel it guessed the top of the screen, but KWin lays side panels out below full-width top panels that reserve space, so every tooltip and popup of the side panel was computed as if the panel started that many pixels higher. The guessed position for side panels now accounts for the space reserved by full-width top and bottom panels on the same screen, following KWin's layout order, and side panels are moved again when such a panel's reserved space changes.

commits.message:
shell/panelview: Tell popups where side panels really are

Side panels assumed they started at the top of the screen, while the
compositor lays them out below top panels, so their tooltips and popups
opened shifted up by the top panel's height. Account for those panels.

BUG: 518087

media.caption: Left panel plus a 60 px top panel on master: the Dolphin tooltip opens 60 px above its icon (centre y=193, icon y=253).
With the fix the tooltip is centred on the Dolphin icon (y=152-354, centre 253).
Kickoff from the left panel on master opens at y=60 and covers the bottom of the top panel.
With the fix Kickoff opens at y=68, level with the top of the side panel.

review.text: The bug is that plasmashell guesses where KWin puts layer-shell panels and libplasma positions popups from that guessed global position. The patch copies KWin's panel layout order into plasmashell (only full-width panels, only Plasma panels), which works for the tested layout but breaks again with fit-content top panels, other layer-shell surfaces with exclusive zones, or any change to KWin's layout. It is a workaround for missing positioning information between KDE projects, and the code already notes the proper path (semantic positioning).
changes: Fix it where the information exists: position the popups and tooltips relative to the panel surface in libplasma (PopupPlasmaWindow: parent-relative placement through xdg_popup/layer_surface.get_popup, the 'semantic positioning' the TODOs in panelview.cpp refer to), or have KWin tell the panel its real position through plasma-wayland-protocols, instead of mirroring KWin's layout rules in PanelView::compositorPosition().
